additional_info.body:
Dear Fernando,
Thank you for reaching
out
to eMobility Support. My name is
Francisco
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / P1 170000133
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
9yZMnV
Problem Description
: HMI is not working
Troubleshooting
: Please check this Q-feedback that I send in attachment. It corresponds to the time where the charger was made. Have you ever replaced this HMI from this specific charger before?
If the steps from the q-feedback are not enough please try this:
Measure input of the controller and confirm 25V
Try to update the FW of the HMI and after following the guide, when we got to the FW update, we could see that the LEDs on top were not light up, even though there were 24.6 V being applied to the controller and the firmware could not recognize the controller:
Initially I believed that it might be a voltage drop from the power supply to the controller and as such we disconnected the cable from pin 4c of F11-XD21 and reconnect it.
After this the voltage was 24.78 V and in the display terminal was 24.73 V:
We measured both sides of the connector to make sure it is not the connector that is faulty and concluded that the connector is not faulty.
Please try using a new DP cable.
If you find the same behaviour then you can replace the HMI.
For future reference, your case number is
0400446
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Francisco de Matos Joaquim

additional_info.subject: ID0400446-DC/Si-D/ES[170000133] - HMI is black CRM:00315002261
additional_info.body:
Hi Fernando, good morning.
I checked all the tickets since the beginning of the year and there was 1 occurrence of a black screen but no related to a FW update.
From our point of view it should be impossible. Have you ever replaced this HMI before? If yes, when. If no, please follow my previous guide.
If you have 24-25V reaching the display controller, it's possible that the PCB is faulty and needs to be replaced.
I will wait for your feedback.
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: ID0400446-DC/Si-D/ES[170000133] - HMI is black CRM:00315002261
additional_info.body:
Hi Fernando,
The only possible problems is either:
The DP cable is faulty or is not inserted properly
In this case you can remove the DP cable and insert again to see if it comes back (wiring issue)
Replace the DP cable
HMI is faulty (PCB)
Replace the whole HMI
Request 3rd party to fix the PCB
Since the charger is out of warranty you can do as you wish, I heard other regions that ask a 3rd party to fix their PCB and it's cheaper
I will wait for your feedback.
BR,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0400446-DC/Si-D/ES[170000133] - HMI is black CRM:00315002261
additional_info.body:
Olá Francisco,
Last Monday I passed from the site during a travel to another site and stops for charge my EV. I can confirm that is possible to charge using the Zunder app but HMI is completely dark (Backlight is on but there is any image).
About the Q-Feedback number Q230, attached I think this is not the route case because the charger was working properly from a long time ago.
Answer her in red to test purposed by you.
Measure input of the controller and confirm 25V
à
There are about 24.7V24.9V
Try to update the FW of the HMI and after following the guide, when we got to the FW update, we could see that the LEDs on top were not light up, even though there were 24.6 V being applied to the controller and the firmware could not recognize the controller:
à
Not tested.  This point never was managed during a training, I need a guide for it and programs.
Initially I believed that it might be a voltage drop from the power supply to the controller and as such we disconnected the cable from pin 4c of F11-XD21 and reconnect it.
à
We have the same Voltage in display terminal and F11-XD21
After this the voltage was 24.78 V and in the display terminal was 24.73 V:
We measured both sides of the connector to make sure it is not the connector that is faulty and concluded that the connector is not faulty.
Please try using a new DP cable.
à
Probe with a new DP cable and USB-C
If you find the same behaviour then you can replace the HMI.
à
In this case we need order and replace all HMI or only the pcb. The HMI is very expensive and try with the PCB could be better?
I think that the HMI is damaged, but how is possible that in only one year we are having this problem? The HMI was replaced 15 months ago for the knowledge problem of delamination. I know that last year we started to use a new HMI maybe this unit use it in the charger is affected by another knowledge issue? We use the same HMI type in another 6 or 7 units and we are worried if all HMI start to fail now again.
@Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD)
I add you in this conversation because although the charger could be out of warranty. The issue in a few time (15 months) after replace could be interest for  study and covering under warranty.
With best regards,

additional_info.subject: ID0400446-DC/Si-D/ES[170000133] - HMI is black CRM:00315002261
additional_info.body:
Hi Roberto, good morning.
Thank you for the feedback. There is no need to include Afonso for these topics.
The HMI then is not working, we have power supply but no function, so that indicates a faulty PCB.
If I understand correctly, there is a period of time where even if the charger is out of warranty, the HMI is still under warranty. I would advise you to reach out to Eric Laemmel from Spare Parts to understand better this process since it’s not in our scope.
From Technical Support we recommend replacing the necessary parts. I heard that in other countries they have found a 3
rd
party that can fix the PCBs for a small amount of money instead of replacing the whole HMI, but from HMI supplier’s side, they don’t send spare PCBs, this means that if you order from Siemens, you will have to order a full new HMI.
With best regards,
